headline: Shriram Finance Reports 59% Profit Surge for Q2 FY27
summary: Shriram Finance released Q2 FY27 results showing a 59% profit surge with assets under management topping Rs 3.3 trillion.
why: Shriram Finance is a major Indian non-banking financial company catering to retail and commercial vehicle credit markets.

impacts.name: Shriram Finance Ltd
impacts.why: Strong earnings growth and expanding assets under management signal robust underlying financial health.

why_moved: A sharp rise in quarterly profit exceeded expectations, driving positive market reactions.
